basic_profile.bio: CastleCrafter101 is a 29-year-old game enthusiast from the Pacific Northwest. They have a deep love for strategy games, especially ones that involve building and managing kingdoms, like 'Kingdoms and Castles.' When not gaming, they enjoy editing videos and discussing plot twists in shows like 'The Undoing.' They work as a freelance video editor, which allows them a flexible schedule to engage with their hobbies. Single and living with a couple of roommates, they often find themselves online during late-night hours when creativity strikes.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: CastleCrafter101 has a background in digital media, having studied film and video production in college. Their expertise in video editing has been honed through both formal education and extensive hands-on practice, including working on indie projects and personal YouTube channels. Their interest in games and shows is driven by a passion for storytelling and visual creativity.
